title: Thacker Pass Mine Reclamation Permit
summary: The Thacker Pass reclamation permit defines authorized disturbance, closure and reclamation obligations, and financial assurance exceeding $47 million.
key_findings: The permit establishes a project-specific reclamation obligation.
NDEP reports financial assurance of more than $47 million to support site reclamation.
Financial assurance is a risk-control mechanism, not evidence that reclamation or operating performance has occurred.
why_it_matters: It adds a concrete long-tail liability and financial-assurance layer to the project dossier.
ftfn_relevance: Connects land disturbance to enforceable reclamation obligations.
Creates later checks for bond updates, disturbance, closure, and reclamation outcomes.
evidence_limits: The permit does not prove current disturbance or successful reclamation.
Financial assurance does not establish compliance, production, or local benefit.
